links.outcome: Endoscopist diagnostic performance decreased after receiving simulated AI diagnosis (inappropriate response to AI)
links.effect: Inappropriate response to AI observed in 28.2% of endoscopists; accuracy rose from 71.4% to 73.7% overall (P<0.001); 41.0% shifted to a more conservative attitude.
links.quote: Inappropriate response to AI was observed in 28.2 % of endoscopists.

links.outcome: Human-AI team performance versus endoscopists alone, including inappropriate reliance on AI
links.effect: Accuracy 71.4% before vs 73.7% after AI (P<0.001), but 28.2% of endoscopists had decreased diagnostic performance after AI.
links.quote: Inappropriate response to AI was observed in 28.2 % of endoscopists.

unlisted_practices: Familiarizing endoscopists with their own optical diagnostic performance and the AI system's performance before AI use

screen.reason: Empirical reader study examining human-AI interaction by comparing endoscopist diagnostic performance before and after receiving simulated AI assistance.

primary.practice: clinician interaction and response to AI decision support
